messages.subject: Monicca | Industrial & Energy Executive | ESG, Government Relations and APAC Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Monicca,

Your leadership across Kestria China and Singapore, together with your Industrial and Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure focus, makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where industrial growth depends on government relations, ESG and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness. My experience working within a Chinese multinational mining group and completing executive development in China adds direct cross-cultural exposure relevant to Asia-based leadership environments.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in industrial, energy, mining and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to Singapore, wider APAC, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
